items.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022
items.q: on the soprano I have a Keilwerth that was given to me by Michael years ago.

ctx.x: Well I’ll lighten up a little bit. I don’t usually ask people about their gear, but I had a thing this morning I had to play tenor and I reminded myself what a lousy horn I have. Can you tell me what sax and mouthpiece you use? © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

Yes. On the tenor I have a P. Mauriat. I’m endorsed by the company and I met him probably 15 years ago at one of the JEN conferences and I tried them and I really really dig them right away. And I have a nice Mark VI also. But it’s a beautiful one, somebody bought it, used it for a month, put it away and sold it to me 50 years later or something like that, or 40 years later. But as I always say it’s “flarp.” It’s flarp. It’s flat and sharp. So on the palm key you have to do so much movement from one note to the…
They’re getting more expensive as the time goes by.
